title: Signs an animal video is AI-generated
caption:
The owl is fake. The checklist is real.

Each tiger's stripe pattern is unique, which is why researchers can identify individuals from photos; generated animals often can't keep a pattern consistent.

Source: Meta newsroom (Feb & Apr 2024); Smithsonian's National Zoo. Real clip: Wikimedia Commons; AI clip: Google DeepMind Veo 3 demo (public domain), labelled on screen.
